caption: The drawing features a wooden object resembling a clamp with a handle. The clamp is colored in various shades of light brown and beige, showing wood grain details, and has a rounded, cushion-like top that is pink in color and appears textured, possibly fabric. The clamp consists of an upper section with the pink cushion, a middle section with a threaded screw component, and a long, smoothly turned wooden handle at the bottom. The clamp is shown vertically oriented. Near the bottom right corner of the image, there is a small inset black-and-white drawing showing a close-up of a hand using the object: the clamp is attached to the edge of a surface, and the hand is manipulating fabric over the pink cushion section.
